purpose: Teach: 洗浄/貸付/清算/通商/投機/知名度/推計/税込み

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験機器の洗浄は徹底しろ
lines.en: Ren, make sure the equipment gets cleaned thoroughly.
lines.style: Crisp, direct instruction. Low warmth but not unkind. Weight lands on 「徹底しろ」— expectation, not threat. Measured pace, no hurry.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の貸付申請を進めております
lines.en: Yes. I'm working on the research fund application now.
lines.style: Respectful, quick. Slight breath-catch before the update — eager to show forward motion. Keeps eyes on the task, not on approval. Steady tempo.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の清算は月末までに行え
lines.en: Ren, get the research fund accounting settled by month-end.
lines.style: Clear, specific directive. Same steady authority as before. Slight emphasis on 「月末まで」— this is a deadline. No room for interpretation, but delivered without irritation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。通商と科学技術の関連も研究中です
lines.en: Yes. I'm also researching connections between trade and science policy.
lines.style: Respectful but with quiet detail-focus. Almost thinking aloud—showing his work. Slight lift at the end, as if asking if this direction is right. Not defensive, just careful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データを投機的に解釈するな
lines.en: Ren, don't interpret the data speculatively.
lines.style: Sharper now. The word 「投機的に」hits with light warning. Not anger—correction. Eyes narrowed slightly. Direct, no padding. Still professional but with an edge.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で論文の知名度を高めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll work on raising the profile of our paper at the conference.
lines.style: Quick, compliant. Absorbs the warning without flinching. Moves to the next thing—shows he's listening and moving. Slight tension in the shoulders. Professional but subdued.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験回数を推計して計画しろ
lines.en: Ren, estimate the number of trials and plan accordingly.
lines.style: Back to steady instruction. The sharpness fades. This is guidance again, not correction. Methodical. Expects competence and gives space for it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会費は税込みで予算に組み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll factor in the conference fee with tax included in the budget.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Quieter, slightly relieved. The pressure lifts—back to detail work. Small, genuine focus. The efficiency of someone who knows what to do. Fades just slightly at the end.
